variants.headline: Party divides in two
variants.body: The party {party} has split, with {splinter} the new breakaway party. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: A political organisation breaks apart
variants.body: A split in {party} has produced the new party {splinter}. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Unity gives way to a party split
variants.body: The new party {splinter} has broken away from {party}. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
